purpose: Teach: 増員/測る/オーブン/カルテ/当番/仕上げる/仕切り/引き換え

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 人員、若手、増員を進めろ。
lines.en: Increase hiring. Focus on bringing in younger staff.
lines.style: Clipped, decisive. Each phrase lands with authority. Brief pause between thoughts. No warmth, no elaboration — this is instruction, not discussion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。製品の寸法、再度、測る予定です。
lines.en: Understood. We're planning to remeasure the product dimensions.
lines.style: Steady, professional acknowledgment. Slight uplift on 「はい」 to show readiness. Even delivery, no enthusiasm but no reluctance either. Factual.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社食、オーブン、新型導入したか。
lines.en: Did we install the new cafeteria oven model yet?
lines.style: Direct question, mid-tone. Lean forward slightly in posture. Not demanding — checking status. Light curiosity underneath the practicality.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内のカルテ、デジタル化を進めます。
lines.en: Yes. We're moving forward with digitizing our internal records system.
lines.style: Measured response. Voice steady and level. Not rushing — he's keeping pace with the directive. Slight emphasis on the action word to show progress.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: Who's on security rotation this week?
lines.style: Quick, businesslike. No buildup. Tone suggests this is one item on a longer list. Expects a straight answer.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品、仕上げる段階に入りました。
lines.en: Yes. The new product is entering the finishing phase.
lines.style: Clear and composed. Slight emphasis on the progress milestone. Voice maintains professional distance — reporting upward, not conversing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 仕切り役、ベテランで固めろ。
lines.en: Put experienced people in charge. Keep senior hands leading.
lines.style: Firm directive. Short phrases, no filler. Authority in the rhythm. Expects implementation without question.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。割引、引き換え券、配布済みです。
lines.en: Yes. The discount vouchers have been distributed already.
lines.style: Conclusive tone. Voice lands firmly on completion — task done. Slight exhale at the end suggesting a line item checked off.
